observations.says: at half past two the yard gate was fast
at half past three it was on the latch: it was opened in the hour between
the one round missing from the card is the round at three, in that hour
the card has no round at three: Ward was not at the station in that hour
the gate was opened with a key between half past two and half past three
Tanner, in splints since Saturday, could not have stood under a bale of silk
only Ward and Tanner have keys to the gate
Ward's statement, that he made every round, is false
